s246.v:
(1)
radha-krsna nibedana ei jana kore
donhe ati rasamaya sa-karuna-hrdaya
abadhana kara natha more

s246.t: 1) O Radha and Krsna, this person presents an appeal before you. You are both very chamring and full of nectar, and Your hearts are full of compassion. My Lords, please listen to my request.

s246.v:
(2)
he krsna gokulacandra gopijana-vallabha
he krsna-preyasi-siromani
hema-gauri syama-gaya sravane parasa paya
guna suni' judaya parani

s246.t: 2) O dark-complexioned Krsna, O moon of Gokula, O lover of the gopis, O golden-complexioned Radha, O crest-jewel of the gopis who are so dear to Krsna, please hear my glorification of Your transcendental virtues, and please accept the offering of my entire life that I place before You. Please let my appeal touch Your ears.

s246.v:
(3)
adhama-durgati-jane kevala karuna mane
tribhuvana e jasah-kheyati
suniya sadhura mukhe sravana lai nu sukhe
upekhile nahi mora gati

s246.t: 3) O My Lords, the narration of Your transcendental glories is like a ferryboat which enables the devotees to cross beyond the three material worlds. O my Lords, You are very merciful to this fallen and misdirected person. Please listen to this appeal from the mouth of Your devotee. Let his words touch Your ears. Please do not neglect me.

s246.v:
(4)
jaya radhe jaya krsna jaya jaya radhe krsna
krsna krsna jaya jay radhe
anjali mastake kori' narottama bhume padi'
kahe donhe purao manah-sadhe

s246.t: 4) O Radha, all glories to You. O Krsna all glories to You. O Radha and Krsna, all glories, all glories to You. O Krsna, O Krsna, all glories to You, O Radha, all glories to You. Narottama dasa places His folded hands upon his head, and falls to the ground before You. Please fulfill the desires of his heart.

s247.v:
(1)
hari hari ki mora karama-gati manda
braje radha-krsna-pada na bhajinu tila-ardha
na bujhinu ragera sambandha

s247.t: 1) O Lord Hari, Lord Hari, how slow I am! I refuse to worship the lotus feet of Radha and Krsna in Vrajabhumi even for half a moment, and I am completely unable to understand the mellows of transcendental love.

s247.v:
(2)
swarupa sanatana rupa raghunatha bhatta-yuga
bhugarbha sri-jiva lokanatha
inha sabhara pada-padma na sevinu tila-ardha
ara kise puribeka sadha

s247.t: 2) Even for half a moment I will not worship the lotus feet of Srila Svarupa Damodara Gosvami, Srila Sanatana Gosvami, Srila Rupa Gosvami, Srila Raghunatha dasa Gosvami, Srila Raghunatha Bhatta Gosvami, Srila Gopala Bhatta Gosvami, Srila Bhugarbha Gosvami, Srila Jiva Srila, and Srila Lokanatha Gosvami. How will it be possible for me to attain my desire?

s247.v:
(3)
krsnadasa kaviraja rasika bhakata-majha
jenho kaila caitanya-carita
gaura-govinda-lila sunite galaye sila
tahate na haila mora cite

s247.t: 3) Among the devotees Krsnadasa Kaviraja is extremely expert at relishing the transcendental nectar of the mellows of love of God. When the stones hear his Caitanya-caritamrta and Govinda-lilamrta, they begin to melt in ecstasy. In spite of this, I cannot appreciate him within my heart.

s247.v:
(4)
se saba bhakata-sanga je karila tara sanga
tara sange kene nahila basa
ki mora duhkhera katha janama gonainu vrtha
dhik dhik narottama dasa

s247.t: 4) Furthermore, I refuse even to associate with the friends and companions of these great souls. How sad is my tale. I have spent my life uselessly. Fie, fie on this Narottama dasa.

s248.v:
(1)
praneswara nibedana ei jana kore
govinda gokulacandra parama ananda-kanda
gopi-kula-priya dekha more

s248.t: 1) O master of my life, this person places an appeal before You. O Govinda, O moon of Gokula, O source of all transcendental bliss, O beloved of the gopis, please cast Your glance upon me.

s248.v:
(2)
tuya pada-padma-seba eidhana more diba
tumi natha karunara nidhi
parama mangala jasa sravane parama rasa
kara kiba karya nahe siddhi

s248.t: 2) O my Lord, You are an ocean of mercy, and the service of Your lotus feet are my constant treasure. Hearing Your supremely auspicious glories is the greatest nectar for the ears. If You bestow Your mercy, then what difficult task cannot be accomplished?

s248.v:
(3)
daruna-samsara-gati bisama-bisaya-mati
tuya bismarana-sela buke
jarajara tanu mana acetana anuksana
jiyante marana bhela duhkhe

s248.t: 3) I wander through this world of suffering, my mind fixed on the objects of the senses which bring only pain, and my chest pierced by the javelin of forgetfulness of You. My body and mind are withered and shattered, and from moment I become unconscious. Immersed in pain, I am like a living corpse.

s248.v:
(4)
mo-hena adhama jane kara krpa-niriksane
dasa kari' rakha vrndabane
sri-krsna-caitanya-nama prabhu mora gaura-dhama
narottama laila sarane

s248.t: 4) Please give me Your merciful glance. Make me Your servant, and allow me to stay in Vrndavana. That goledn-complexioned person who bears the name Sri Krsna Caitanya is my master, Narottama dasa takes shelter of Him.

s249.v:
(1)
hari hari krpa kari' rakha nija-pade
kama krodha chaya jane lana phire nana sthane
bisaya-bhunjaya nana-mate

s249.t: 1) O Lord Hari, O Lord Hari, please give me shelter at Your feet. Lust and anger are the leaders of the group of six men who impell me to wander here and there in the attempt to enjoy varieties of sense-gratification.

s249.v:
(2)
haiya mayara dasa kari' nana abhilasa
tomara smarana gela dure
artha-labha ei ase kapata-baisnaba-bese
bhramiya bulaye ghare ghare

s249.t: 2) I am full of material desires and I have become the servant of material illusion. My memory of You has fled far asay. Disguised as a Vaisnava I wander from house to house, motivated by the desire to accumulate wealth.

s249.v:
(3)
aneka duhkhera pare layechile braja-pure
krpa-dora galaya bandhiya
daiva-maya balat kare khasaiya sei dore
bhaba kupe dileka dhariya

s249.t: 3) In this town of Vraja, which is situated beyond all these sufferings, You have tied me about the neck with your rope of mercy. Seeing this outrage, the illusory energy loosened those ropes and again threw my into the well of material existence.

s249.v:
(4)
punah yadi krpa-kari' e janare kese dhari'
taniya tulai braja-dhame
tabe se dekhiya bhala natuba parana gela
kahne dina dasa narottama

s249.t: 4) If You are again merciful You will grasp this person by the hair, rescue him from illusion's well, and place him in the abode of Vraja. Seeing that the Lord placed him in an auspicious condition of life, whereas otherwise his life would have perished, the poor and fallen Narottama dasa sings this song.

s250.v:
(1)
hari hari bada sela marame rahila
paiya durlabha tanu sri-krsna-bhajan binu
janma mora biphala haila

s250.t:
1) O Lord Hari, O Lord Hari, a great javelin has pierced me in the core of the heart.
Having attained this difficult to get human body, I have neglected the worship of Sri Krsna, and in this way my life has become useless.

s250.v:
(2)
brajendranandana hari nabadwipe abatari'
jagat bhariya prema dila
muni se pamara-mati bisese kathina ati
teni more karuna nahila

s250.t: 2) Although Lord Hari, the prince of Vraja, has descended in Navadvipa and filled the universe with pure love of God, I remain very sinful at heart, cruel, and merciless.

s250.v:
(3)
swarupa sanatana rupa raghunatha bhatta-yuga
tahate na haila mora mati
dibya cintamani dhama brndabana hena sthana
sei dhame na kainu vasati

s250.t: 3) My mind refuses to think of Srila Svarupa Damodara Gosvami, Srila Sanatana Gosvami, Srila Rupa Gosvami, Srila Raghunatha dasa Gosvami, Srila Raghunatha Bhatta Gosvami, Srila Gopala Bhatta Gosvami. I decline to make my residence in Vrndavana-dhama, the abode full of transcendental cintamani gems.

s250.v:
(4)
bisesa bisaye mati nahila baisnabe rati
nirantara kheda uthe mane
narottma dasa kahe jibara ucita nahe
sri-guru-baisnaba-seba bine

s250.t: 4) My mind is absorbed in sense-gratification, and I do not take pleasure in the association of devotees. For this reason pain and regret arise within my heart. Narottama dasa says: It is not good to live without serving the spiritual master and the Vaisnavas.

s251.v:
(1)
hari hari ki mora karama abhaga
biphale jibana gela hrdaye rahila sela
nahi bhela hari-anuraga

s251.t: 1) O Lord Hari, Lord Hari, everything that I do is inauspicious. I have uselessly wasted my life, and I have no love for You. It is as if my heart were pierced by a sharp javelin.

s251.v:
(2)
yajna dhana tirtha-snana punya-karma japa dhyana
akarane saba gela mohe
bujhilama mane hena upahasa haya jena
bastraphina alankara dehe

s251.t: 2) Vedic sacrifices, charity, bathing in holy places of pilgrimage, pious deeds, mantra-chanting, and meditation, are all useless and illusory. When I think of these things laughter arises within my mind. Engaging in these activities without performing devotional service is like placing valuable ornaments on a body colthed in rags.

s251.v:
(3)
sadhu-mukhe kathamrta suniya bimala cita
nahi bhela aparadha-karana
satata asat-sanga sakali haila bhanga
ki kariba aile samana

s251.t: 3) Although I sometimes hear the nectarean message of Godhead from the mouths of the devotees, because I commit so many offenses, I do not become purified. I continually associate with non-devotees, and in this way all my spiritual advancement is broken apart. Furthermore, death will soon appear on my horizon.

s251.v:
(4)
sruti smrti sada rabe suniyachi ei sabe
hari-pada abhaya sarana
janama laiya sukhe krsna na balinu mukhe
na karinu se rupa-bhabana

s251.t: 4) Although I have repeatedly heard the Sruti and Smrti scriptures' declaration that one should take shelter of the Lord Hari's lotus feet in order to become fearless, nevertheless I refuse to happily chant the holy name of Lord Krsna, and I decline to meditate on His transcendental form.

s251.v:
(5)
radha-krsna dunhu-paya tanu mana rahu taya
ara dure jauka basana
narottama dase kaya ara mora hani bhaya
tanu mana sampinu apana

s251.t: 5) I shall now concentrate my mind on the lotus feet of Sri Sri Radha and Krsna, and all my material desires will flee far away. Narottama dasa says---Now that I have fixed my mind on Sri Sri Radha and Krsna, I am no longer afraid of my future.

s252.v:
(1)
hari hari hena dina haibe amara
dunhu anga parasiba hunhu anga nirakhiba
sebana kariba donhakara

s252.t: 1) O Lord Hari, O Lord Hari, when will this day be mine? When will I see Your lotus feet? When will I drectly serve Your lotus feet? When will I touch Your lotus feet?

s252.v:
(2)
lalita-bisakha-sange sebana kariba range
mala ganthi' diba nana phule
kanaka-samputa kari' karpura tambula puri'
yogaiba adhara-jugale

s252.t: 2) When, in the association of Lalita and Visakha, will I be able to directly serve You; When will I be albe to spend my days making garlands for You? When will I be able to fill a golden casket with camphor and betel-nuts, and then place these betel-nuts directly in Your mouth?

s252.v:
(3)
radha-krsna brndabana ei mora prana-dhana
ei mora jibana-upaya
jaya patita-pabana deha more ei dhana
toma-bine anya nahi bhaya

s252.t: 3) Sri Sri Radha-Krsna, and Their abode of Vrndavana are the valuable treasure of my life. It is they who sustain me. O deliverer of the fallen, please give this treasure to me, for I have no one to turn to, except for You.

s252.v:
(4)
sri-guru karuna-sindhu adhama-janera bandhu
lokantha lokera jibana
ha ha prabhu kara daya deha more pada-chaya
narottama laila sarana

s252.t: 4) O my spiritual master, O ocean of mercy, O friend of the fallen , O Lokanatha Gosvami, O life of the people, O master, please be merciful to me. Please give me the shade of your lotus feet. Narottama dasa takes shelter of you.

s253.v:
(1)
hari hari kabe mora haibe su-dine
keli-kautuka-range kariba sebane

s253.t: 1) O Lord Hari, Lord Hari, when will I directly serve You as You engage in blissful transcendental pastimes? When will that auspicious day be mine?

s253.v:
(2)
lalita-visakha sane jateka sangira gane
mandali kariba donha
meli' rai kanu kare dhari' nrtya kare phiri' phiri'
nirakhi' gona'ba kutuhali

s253.t: 2) When in the company of Lalita, Visakha, and their friends, will I directly meet Sri Sri Radha and Krsna? When, seeing Them dancing in Their transcendental pastimes, will my voice become choked up with ecstatic love?

s253.v:
(3)
alasa-bisrama-ghare gobardhana giri-bare
rai kanu karibe sayana
narottama dasa kaya ei jena mora haya
anuksana carana sebana

s253.t: 3) After the dancing pastimes are concluded, Sri Sri Radha and Krsna will take rest in a cottage on Govardhana Hill, the best of mountains. Narottama dasa says: I pray that I shall be able to continually serve the lotus feet of the Divine couple.

s254.v:
(1)
gobardhana giri-bare kebala nirjana sthala
rai kanu karibe sayane
lalita-bisakha-sange sebana kariba range
sukhamaya ratula carane

s254.t: 1) In a solitary place on Govardhana Hill, the best of mountains, Sri Sri Radha and Krsna sit on a couch, when, accompanied by Lalita and Visakha, will I jubilantly serve Their reddish lotus feet?

s254.v:
(2)
kanaka samputa kari' karpura tambula bhari'
jogaiba badana-kamale
manimaya kinkini ratana nupura ani'
paraiba carana-jugale

s254.t: 2) When will I take camphor and betel-nuts from a golden box, and place it in Their lotus mouths? When will I give them sashes made with jewelled bells, and when will I place jewelled ankle-bells on Their lotus feet?

s254.v:
(3)
kanaka katora puri' sugandhi candana buri'
donhakara sri-ange dhaliba
guru-rupa sakhi bame tribhanga bhangima thame
camarera batasa kariba

s254.t: 3) When will I fill a golden goblet for the Divine couple? When will I anoint Their limbs with aromatic sandalwood paste? When, my spiritual master in his original form as a gopi, at my left, will I fan Their three-fold bending forms with a camara wisk?

s254.v:
(4)
donhara kamala ankhi pulaka haiya dekhi'
dunhu pada parisaba kare
caitanya-darsea dasa mane matra abhilasa
narottama dase sada sphure

s254.t: 4) When, seeing the lotus eyes of the Divine couple, will the hairs of my body stand up in ecstasy? When will I be able to directly touch Their lotus feet? Narottama dasa, who is the servant of Lord Caitanya's servants, desires in this way. He has no other desires.

s255.v:
(1)
hari hari ara ki emana dasa
kabe brsabhanu-pure ahiri gopera ghare
tanaya haiya janamiba

s255.t: 1) When will I take birth as a gopi in the town of Maharaja Vrsabhanu, where many gopas and gopis live? O Lord Hari, Lord Hari, will I someday attain this condition of life?

s255.v:
(2)
jabate amara kabe e prani-grahana habe
basati kariba bake taya
sakhira parama srestha je tahara haya prestha
sevana kariba tanra paya

s255.t: 2) When will I live in the city of Vrsabhanu and be accepted by its residents as one of their kin? When will I become the dear friend of the exalted gopis, and when will I be able to directly serve them?

s255.v:
(3)
tenha krpaban haina ratula carane lana
amare karibe samarpana
saphala haibe dasa puribe manera asa
se dunhara jugala-carana

s255.t: 3) When Lord Krsna is merciful to me I will be able to attain His reddish lotus feet. When I attain the louts feet of the Divine couple, then my life will be successful, and all the desires of my mind will be fulfilled.

s255.v:
(4)
brndabane dui-jana caturddike sakhi-gana
sebana kariba abasese
sakhi-gana caribhite nana jantra laina hate
dekhiba manera abhilase

s255.t: 4) When will I be able to directly serve the Divine Couple, who are surrounded by Their gopi-friends? When I obtain the facility to directly serve the Divine Couple in the association of the gopis, then all the desires of my mind will be fulfilled.

s255.v:
(5)
dunhu canda-mukha dekhi' judabe tapita ankhi
nayane bahibe asru-dhara
brndara nidesa paba donhara nikate jaba
hena dina haiba amara

s255.t: 5) When will I be able to approach very near to the Divine Couple? When will streams of tears flow from my eyes by seeing the moonlike faces of the Divine Couple? when will I receive direct orders from Vrnda-devi, the close friend of the the Divine Couple? When will that day be mine?

s255.v:
(6)
sri-rupa-manjari sakhi more anathini dekhi'
rakhibe ratula duti paya
narottama dasa bhane priya-narma-sakhi-gane
kabe dasi karibe amara

s255.t: 6) When will Sri Rupa-manjari, seeing me helpless and without any shelter, become my protectress? When will I attain the shelter of the reddish lotus feet of the Divine Couple? Narottama dasa; When will I become one of the maidservants of the gopis?

s256.v:
(1)
hari hari ara ki emana dasa haba
chadiya purusa--deha kabe ba prakrti haba
dunhu ange candana paraba

s256.t: 1) When, relinquishing this male material body, and obtaining the spiritual body of a gopi, will I anoint the limbs of the Divine Couple with sandalwood paste? O Lord Hari, Lord Hari, when will this day be mine?

s256.v:
(2)
taniya bandhiba cuca naba gunja-hare beda
nana phule ganthi diba hara
pita-basana ange paraiba sakhi-sange
badane tambula diba ara

s256.t: 2) When will I arrange the hair of the Divine Couple? When will I give them gunja-necklaces and garlands; strung with various flowers? When will I give Them yellow garments? When, accompanied by the other gopis, will I place betel-nuts in Their lotus mouths?

s256.v:
(3)
dunhu rupa manohari deriba nayana bhari'
nilambare rai sajaiya
naba-ratna-jari ani bandhiba bicitra beni
tate phula malati ganthiya

s256.t: 3) When will gaze at the beautiful forms of the Divine Couple? When will I dress Srimati Radharani in blue garments, and decorate her braided hair with garlands of jasmine flowers and strings of nine different kinds of jewels on a golden thread.

s256.v:
(4)
sei rupa-madhuri dekhiba nayana bhari'
ei kari mane abhilasa
jaya rupa sanatana deha more ei dhana
nibedaye narottama dasa

s256.t: 4) My desire is that some day I shall be able to directly see the sweet beauty of the transcendental forms of the Divine Couple. O Srila Rupa Gosvami and Srila Sanatana Gosvami, all glories to you both. Please bestow this treasure upon me. Please grant my desire. Narottama dasa appeals to you in this way.

s257.v:
(1)
hari hari kabe mora haibe sudina
gobardhana giri-bare parama nibhrta ghare
rai kanu karaiba sayana

s257.t: 1) When, in a secluded cottage on Govardhana Hill, the best of mountains, will I prepare a couch for Sri Sri Radha and Krsna? O Lord Hari, Lord Hari, when will that auspicious day be mine?

s257.v:
(2)
bhrngarera jale ranga- carana dhoyaiba
muchaba apana cikure
kanaka-samputa kar'i karpura tambula puri'
jogaiba dunhuka adhare

s257.t: 2) When will I take water from a jar and wash the lotus feet of the Divine Couple? When will I then dry Their feet using my own har as a towel? When, from a golden box will I take betel-nuts and camphor, and place them on the lotus-lips of the Divine Couple?

s257.v:
(3)
priya-sakhi-gana-sange sebana kariba range
carana sebiba nija-kare
kunhuka kamala-dithi kautuka heraba
dunhu anga pulaka antare

s257.t: 3) When, in the association of the gopis, will I directly serve the lotus feet of the Divine Couple with my own hand? When, by seeing the lotus eyes of the Divine Couple, will the hairs of my body stand erect because of the ecstasy within my heart?

s257.v:
(4)
mallika malati juthi nana phule mala ganthi
kabe diba donhara galaya
sonara katora kari karpura candana bhari'
kabe diba donhakara gaya

s257.t: 4) When shall I string garlands of mallika and malati flowers and place them on the necks of the Divine Couple? When shall I fill a golden goblet with camphor and sandalwood paste, and then anoint the transcendental forms of the Divine Couple with this mixture?

s257.v:
(5)
ara kabe emana habe dunu--mukha-nirakhiba
lila-rasa nijunja-sayane
sri-kundalatara sange keli-kautuka range
narottama karibe srabane

s257.t: 5) When will I directly see the lotus faces of the Divine Couple? When will Narottama dasa jubilantly hear Kundalata-devi's narration of the nectarean pastimes performed by the Divine Couple in the groves of Vrndavana? When will that day be?

s258.v:
(1)
ei naba-dasi bali sri-rupa cahibe
hena subha-ksana mora kati-dine habe

s258.t: 1) When will I be a young gopi-maidservant? When will Sri Rupa-manjari directly order me? When will that auspicious time be?

s258.v:
(2)
sighra ajna karibena---dasi hetha aya
sebara susajja-karya karaha twaraya

s258.t: 2) When will Sri Rupa-manjari repeatedly order me about, saying: "O maidservant, come here. Quickly arrange for my fancy garments and ornaments."

s258.v:
(3)
anandita hana hiya ajna-bale
pabitra manete karya karibe tat-kale

s258.t: 3) By hearing these orders I will become delighted. These orders will completely absorb the attention of my purified.

s258.v:
(4)
sebara samagri ratna-khalate kariya
subasita bari swarna-jharite puriya

s258.t: 4) When, in Sri Rupa-manjari's service, will I fill a jewelled tray with various paraphernalia for worship? When, engaged in her service. will I fill a golden goblet with aromatic water?

s258.v:
(5)
donhara sammukhe la' ye diba sighra-gati
narottamera dasa kabe haibe e-mati

s258.t: 5) When will I be able to quickly approach the Divine Couple? When will Narottama dasa attain this condition of life?

s259.v:
(1)
sri-rupa pascate ami rahiba bhita hana
donhe punah kahibena ama pane cana

s259.t: 1) I timidly follow behind Sri Rupa-manjari. When will she say to me; "Fetch some water for the Divine Couple?

s259.v:
(2)
sadaya hrdaya donhe kahibena hasi
kothaya paile rupa ei naba dasi

s259.t: 2) When will the Divine Couple, compassionately smiling, say: "Where has Rupa-manjari gotten this young maidservant?"
3) Hearing these words, Sri Rupa-manjari will say: "Manjunali gave this maidservant to me.

s259.v:
(4)
ati namra-citta ami haibe janila
seba-karya niya tabe hethaya rakhila

s259.t: 4) At tha time I will feel very humble at heart, and I will diligently engage in the service of the Divine Couple.

s259.v:
(5)
hena tattwa konhakare saksate kahiya
narottame sebaya dibe mijukta kariya

s259.t: 5) When will the Divine Couple directly speak in this way to Narottama dasa, engaging him in Their service?

s260.v:
(1)
ha ha prabhu lokanatha rakha pada--dwandwe
krpa-drste caha jadi haiya anande

s260.t: 1) O Lokanatha Gosvami, O my master, please place me at your lotus feet. If you are pleased with me, please place your merciful glance upon me.

s260.v:
(2)
mano-bancha siddhi tabe nana purna-trsna
hethaya caitanya mile setha radha-krsna

s260.t: 2) If you are satisfied with me, then all the wishes of my mind will be fulfilled, and attained, and my thirst for happiness will be satiated. If you are satisfied with me, then I will attain the association of Lord Caitanya. If you are satisied with me, then I may be able to attain the association of Sri Sri Radha and Krsna.

s260.v:
(3)
tumi na karile daya ke karibe are
manera basana purna kara ei bara

s260.t: 3) O master, if you do not become merciful to me, then what will become of me? Please fulfill my mind's desire, at least this one time.

s260.v:
(4)
e tina samsare mora ara keha nai
krpa kari' pada-tale deha thani

s260.t: 4) In the entire world there is no one as much in need of your mercy as I am.. Please be merciful to me, and give me shelter at the soles of your lotus feet.

s260.v:
(5)
radha-krsna-lila-guna gana ratri-dine
narottma -baancha purna nahe tuya bine

s260.t: 5) Although he spends all his days and nights glorifying the transcendental pastimes and attributes of Sri Sri Radha and Krsna, nevertheless Narottama dasa knows that his desire to attain Their association cannot be fulfilled without your mercy.

s261.v:
(1)
lokanatha prabhu tumi daya kara more
radha-krsna-carana jena sada citte sphure

s261.t: 1) O Lokanatha, O my master, please be merciful to me and bless me tha Sri Sri Radha-Krsna's lotus feet may be always manifested within my mind.

s261.v:
(2)
tomara sahita thaki sakhira sahite
ei ta' basana mora sada uthe cite

s261.t: 2) I wish to have your association when you manifest your form as a gopi-friend of the Divine Couple. This desire continually arises in my mind.

s261.v:
(3)
sakhi-gan-jyestha jenho tanhara carana
mora samarpibe kabe sebara karane

s261.t: 3) O master, when, by your mercy, will I be allowed to serve the lotus feet of Srimati Radharani, the best of all gopis.

s261.v:
(4)
tabe se haibe mora banchita purana
anande sebiba donhara jugala carana

s261.t: 4) If you fulfill my desire, then I shall be able to blissfully serve the lotus feet of the Divine Couple.

s261.v:
(5)
sri-rupa-manjari sakhi krpa-drste cana
tapi narottame sinca sebamrta diya

s261.t: 5) O Sri Rupa-manjari, O friend of the Divine Couple, please cast your glance of mercy upon me. Please sprinkle this disreessed Narottama dasa with the nectar of your devotional service.

s262.v:
(1)
ha ha prabhu kara daya karuna tomara
micha maya-jale tanu dahiche amara

s262.t: 1) My body and mind burn in the network of material illusion. O master, be merciful to me, and rescue me from it.

s262.v:
(2)
kabe hena dasa habe sakhi-sanga paba
brndabane phula ganthi donhake paraba

s262.t: 2) When will I attain the association of the gopis? When will I string flower garlands in the forest of Vrndavana, and then place those garlands on the necks of the Divine Couple?

s262.v:
(3)
sammukhe basiya kabe camara dhulaba
aguru-candana-gandha donha ange diba

s262.t: 3) When will I meet the Divine Couple face-to-face? When will I fan Them with a camara wisk? When will I anoint Their limbs with aguru, sandalwood paste, and other fragrant substances?

s262.v:
(4)
sakhira ajnaya kabe tambula jogaba
sindura tilaka kabe donhake paraba

s262.t: 4) When, following the gopis' orders, will I offer betel-nuts to the Divine Couple? When will I draw artistic tilaka markings in red sindura on the Divine Couple's foreheads?

s262.v:
(5)
bilasa-kautuka keli dekhiba nayane
candra-jukha nirakhiba basaye simhasane

s262.t: 5) When, with my own eyes, will I see the Divine Couple jubilantly perform pastimes? When will I see Their moonlike faces as They sit on Their thrones?

s262.v:
(6)
sada se madhuri dekhi manera lalase
kata-dine habe daya narottama dase

s262.t: 6) O my master, if at some time you are merciful to me, then the desire of my mind will be fulfilled, and I will be able to directly see the transcendental sweetness of the Divine Couple.

s263.v:
(1)
hari hari kabe hena dasa habe mora
sebiba donhara pada anande bibhora

s263.t: 1) When, overwhelmed with bliss, will I directly serve the lotus feet of the Divine Couple? O Lord Hari, Lord Hari, when will I attain this?

s263.v:
(2)
bhramara haiya sada rahiba carane
sri-caranamrta sada kariba aswadane

s263.t: 2) When will I become a bumble-bee staying continually at the lotus feet of the Divine Couple, and continually drinking the honey of those lotus feet?

s263.v:
(3)
eiasa kari ami---jata sakhi-gana
tomadera krpaya je banchita purana

s263.t: 3) This is my desire---to join the company of the gopi-frineds of the Divine Couple. O my master, by your mercy only can my desire be fulfilled.

s263.v:
(4)
bahu-dina bancha kari purna jate haya
sabe meli daya kara haiya sadaya

s263.t: 4) For many days I have desired in this way. Please be merciful to me and fulfill my request.

s263.v:
(5)
seba ase narottama kande diba-nisi
krpa kari' kara more anugata dasi

s263.t: 5) Yearning and hoping in this way, Narottama dasa weeps day and night. Please be merciful to me, and make me your follower and gopi-maidservant.

s264.v:
(1)
hari hari ara ki emana dasa haba
ei bhaba samsara tyaji' parama anande maji'
ara kabe brajabhume jaba

s264.t: 1) When will I renounce the circle of material family life, and, drowning in transcendental bliss, go to Vrajabhumi? O Lord Hari, Lord Hari, when will this be?

s264.v:
(2)
sukhamaya brndaba kaba habe darsana
se dhuli lagibe kabe gaya
preme gadagada haina radha-krsna-nama laina
kandiya bedaba ubharaya

s264.t: 2) When will I see the blissful land of Vrndavana? When will I smear the dust of Vrndavana over my body? When will I walk about Vrndavana, loudly singing the names of Radha and Krsna, and crying, my voice choked with ecstatic love.

s264.v:
(3)
nibhrta nikunja jana astange pranama haina
dakiba ha radha-natha bali
kabe jamunara tire parasa kariba nire
kabe piba kara-pute tuli'

s264.t: 3) When, in a solitary grove in Vrndavana, will I offer my full obeisances to the Divine Couple? When will I call out: "O Krsna, O master of Srimati Radharani"? When, standing on the shore of the Yamuna, will I drink some of its water in my cupped hands?

s264.v:
(4)
ara kabe emana haba sri-rasa-mandale jaba
kabe gadagadi diba taya
bamsibata-chaya pana parama ananda hana
padiya rahiba tara chaya

s264.t: 4) When will this be? When will I go to the arena of the rasa-dance, and roll about in the dust, overwhelmed with ecstasy? When will I visit Vamsivata, and fall down to the ground, overwhelmed by transcendental bliss?

s264.v:
(5)
kabe gobardhana giri dekhiba nayane bhari'
kabe habe radha-kunde basa
bhramite bhramite kabe ei deha patana habe
kahe dina narottama dasa

s264.t: 5) When will I see Govardhana Hill, my eyes filling with tears? When will I reside at Radha-kunda? When, as a result of constantly wandering Vrndavana, will this body fall down? Poor-hearted Narottama dasa speaks in this way.

s265.v:
(1)
hari hari ara kabe palatibe dasa
e saba kariya bame jaba brndabana-dhame
ei mane kariyachi asa

s265.t: 1) When will I renounce all material impediments and go to Vrndavana dhama? O Lord Hari, Lord Hari, when will my life change in this way? I hope I shall be able to change my mode of living in this way.

s265.v:
(2)
dhana jana putra dare e saba kariya dure
ekanta haiya kabe jaba
saba duhkha parihari brndabane basa kari'
madhukari magiya khaiba

s265.t: 2) When will I leave all my wealth, followers, children, and wife far behind, and with only one desire, go to Vrndavana? When will I lelave all material miseries, and live in Vrndavana, eating only whatever foodstuff I can obtain by begging?

s265.v:
(3)
jamunara jala jena amrta samana hena
kabe piba udara puriya
kabe radha-kunda-jale snana kari' kutuhale
syama-kunda rahiba padiya

s265.t: 3) When will I take long drinks of the Yamuna's water, which is as sweet as nectar? When, with great happiness, will I bathe at Radha-kunda? When will I premanently reside at Syama-kunda?

s265.v:
(4)
bhramiba dwadasa bane rasa-keli je je sthane
premabese gadagadi diya
sudhaiba jane jane draja-basi-gana-sthane
nibediba carana dhariya

(5)
bhajanera sthana kabe nayana-gocara habe
ara jata ache upabana
ara madhye brndabana narottma dasera mana
asa kare jugala carana

s265.t: 5) When will I be able to see the gardens of Vrndavana where the great devotees whrshipped the Lord? Narottama dasa hopes to one day attain the lotus feet of the Divine Couple.

s266.v:
(1)
karanga kaupina lana chenda kanha gaya diya
tejagiba sakala bisaya
krsna anuraga habe brajera nikunja kabe
jaina kariba nijalaya

s266.t: 1) When will I renounce all sense-gratification? When will I accept only a water-pot and torn garment? When will I constantly sing Lord Krsna's holy names? When will I go to the groves of Vraja and make my permanent residence there? When will I attain ecstatic love for Lord Krsna?

s266.v:
(2)
hari hari kabe mora haibe su-dina
phala-amula brndabane khana diba-abasane
bhramiba haiya udasina

s266.t: 2) When will I wander in Vrndavana, detached from material affairs, and only eating some roots and fruit at the end of the day? O Lord Hari, Lord Hari, when will that auspicious day be mine?

s266.v:
(3)
sitala jamuna jale snana kari kutuhale
premabese anandita hana
bahura upara bahu tuli' brndabane kuli kuli
krsna bali bedaba kandiya

s266.t: 3) When will I become full of bliss, overwhelmed by ecstatic love by bathing in the cool waters of the Yamuna river? When will I wander about Vrndavana with my arms upraised calling out the name of Lord Krsna, and crying?

s266.v:
(4)
dekhiba sanketa-sthana judabe tapita prana
premabese gadagadi diba
kanha radha praneswari kanha giribara-dhari
kanha natha baliya dakiba

s266.t: 4) When will I see the place where Radha and Krsna secretly met? When, overwhelmed with ecstatic love, will I roll about in the dust at that place? When will I call out; "O Radha, O controller of my life, where are You? O Krsna, O lifter of Govardhana Hill, where are You? O my masters, where are You?"

s266.v:
(5)
madhavi-kunjera 'pari sukhe basi' suka-sari
gaibeka radha-krsna-rasa
taru-mule basi' taha suni' judaiba hiya
kabe sukhe gonaba dibasa

s266.t: 5) When will I happily pass my days at the roots of a tree in the grove of madhavi creepers, listening to a parrot-couple jubilantly sing the glories of the nectarean pastimes of Sri Sri Radha and Krsna?

s266.v:
(6)
sri-govinda gopinatha srimati-radhika-sakha
dekhiba ratana-simhasane
dina narottama dasa karaye durlabha asa
e-mati haibe kata dine

s266.t: 6) When will I see Lord Govinda, the master of the gopis, accompanied by Srimati Radharani, asa They both sit on a jewelled throne? Poor-hearted Narottama dasa hopes that some day he will be able to obtain this so-difficult-to-obtain desire.

s267.v:
(1)
hari hari kabe haba brndabana-basi
nirakhiba nayane jugala-rupa-rasi

s267.t: 1) O Lord Hari, Lord Hari, when will I become a resident of Vrndavana? When with my own eyes, will I see the great beauty of the Divine Couple.

s267.v:
(2)
tyajiya sayana-sukha bicitra palanka
kabe brajera dhulaya dhurasa habe anga

s267.t: 2) When will I renounce very comfortable sleeping arrangements and instead take rest on the ground of Vraja?

s267.v:
(3)
jada-rasa-bhojana dure parihari
kabe braje magiya khaiba madhukari

s267.t: 3) When will I renounce materially palatable foodstuffs, and simply eat whatever I can obtain by begging in the land of Vraja?

s267.v:
(4)
parikrama kariya bedaba bane bane
bisrama kariba jai jamuna-puline

s267.t: 4) When will I circumambulate the land of Vraja, wandering from forest to forest? When, becoming fatigued, will I stop to rest on the shore of the Yamuna?

s267.v:
(5)
tapa dura kariba sitala bamsibate
kabe kunje baithaba hama baisnaba-nikate

s267.t: 5) When will I find relief from the heat of midday by resting in the cooling shade of Vamsivata? When will I associate with the Vaisnavas in the froves of Vrndavana?

s267.v:
(6)
narottama dasa kahe kari' parihara
kabe ba emana dasa haibe amara

s267.t: 6) Narottama dasa renounces the materialistic way of life and says: "When will I attain this perfection of spiritual life?"

s268.v:
(1)
ara ki emana dasa haba
saba chadi' brndabane jaba

s268.t: 1) When will I renounce everything and go to Vrndavana? When will this be?

s268.v:
(2)
ara kabe sri-rasa-mandale
gadagadi diba kutuhale

s268.t: 2) When in great ecstasy will I roll about on the ground where Lord Krsna performed the rasa-dance?

s268.v:
(3)
ara kabe gobardhana giri
dekhiba nayana-juga bhari

s268.t: 3) When will I see Govardhana Hill, my eyes filling with tears.

s268.v:
(4)
syama-kunde radha-kunde snana
kari' kabe judaba parana

s268.t: 4) When by bathing in Syama-kunda and Radha-kunda, will I attain the stage of dedicating my entire life and soul to the service of the Divine Couple?

s268.v:
(5)
ara kabe jamunara jale
majjane haiba niramale

s268.t: 5) When will I become pure at heart by bathing in the waters of the yamuna river?

s268.v:
(6)
sadhu-sange brndabane basa
narottama dasa kabe asa

s268.t: 6) Narottama dasa hopes that he will be able to reside in Vrndavana in the association of the saintly devotees.

s269.v:
(1)
kabe krsna-dhana paba hiyara majhare thoba
judaiba tapita-parana
sajaiya diba hiya basaiba prana-priya
nirakhiba se candra-bayana

s269.t: 1) When will I attain the dark treasure known as Lord Krsna? When, agitated with ecstatic love, will I give my heart to Lord Krsna? When will I consider Lord Krsna more dear to me than my own life's breath? When will I be able to see Lord Krsna's moonlike face?

s269.v:
(2)
he sajani kabe mora haibe su-dina
seprana-nathera sanga kabe ba phiriba range
sukhamaya jamuna-pulina

s269.t: 2) When will I regain my master's association? When will I happily return with singing and dancing to the shore of the Yamuna? O friend, when will this auspicious day be mine.

s269.v:
(3)
lalita bisakha lana tanhare bhetiba giya
sajaiya nana upahare
sadaya haiya bidhi milaibe guna-nidhi
hena bhagya haibe amara

s269.t: 3) When, in the company of Lalita and Visakha, will I meet Lord Krsna? When will I be able to offer various gifts to please Him? When will destiny be compassionate to me? When will my destiny become like a virtuous person who is an ocean of good qualities? When will this good fortune be mine?

s269.v:
(4)
daruna bidhira nata alinga premera hata
tila-matra na rakhila ta'ra
kahe narottama dasa ki mora jibane asa
chadi' gela brajendra-kumara

s269.t: 4) Cruel fate has made me poverty-stricken and i do not have even a penny to purchase the goods sold in the markdetplace of pure love for Krsna. Nevertheless, Narottama dasa says: "My life's hope is to renounce everything and attain the prince of Vraja.

s270.v:
(1)
ei-bara paile dekha carana du' khani
hiyara majhare rakhi' juda'ba parani

s270.t: 1) I pray that I may now see the two lotus feet of Lord Krsna. I shall place these lotus feet in my heart. I will dedicate my entire life and soul to them.

s270.v:
(2)
tan're na dekhiya mora mane bada tapa
anale pasiba kimba jale diba jhampa

s270.t: 2) If I am not able to see Lord Krsna's lotus feet, my heart will burn with suffering. I will end this life by entering a blazing fire, or jumping into the water.

s270.v:
(3)
mukhera muchaba ghama khaojaba pana guja
ghamete batasa diba candanadi cuja

s270.t: 3) When I meet Lord Krsna I will serve Him in various ways. I will wipe the perspiration from His face. I will give Him nice food and drink. I will offer Him betel-nuts. I will fan Him. I will anoint His body with sandalwood paste and other aromatic substances.

s270.v:
(4)
brndabandera phulera ganthiya diba hara
binaiya bandhiba cuda kuntalera bhara

s270.t: 4) I will string a garland of Vrndavana forest flowers, and then present that garland to Lord Krsna. I will carefully arrange His hair and tie His topknot.

s270.v:
(5)
kalape tilaka diba candanera canda
narottama dasa kahe piritera phanda

s270.t: 5) I will decorate Lord Krsna with a peacock feather, tilaka markings, and a moon drawn in sandalwood paste. Narottamadasa says; In this way I will gradually attain love for Lord Krsna.

s271.v:
(1)
kadamba tarura dala namiyache bhume bhala
phutiyache phula sari sari
parimale bharala sakala brndabana
keli kare bhramara bhramari

s271.t: 1) In Vrndavana the kadamba trees offer obeisances, their flowering branches reverentially touching the ground. bumvle bees perform pastimes in that Vrndavana, which is filled with a very sweet fragrance.

s271.v:
(2)
rai kanu bilasai range
kiba rupa labani baidagadha-khani dhani
manimaya abharana ange

s271.t: 2) Radha and Krsna stay in the place where They perform pastimes. How beauriful They are. Their bodies are decorated with jewelled ornaments, and They are like two wealthy aristocrats who own many gem mines of intelligence and with.

s271.v:
(3)
radhara daksina kare dhari' priya giridhari
madhura madhura cali' jaya
age pache sakhi-gana kare phula barisana
kona sakhi camara dhulaya

s271.t: 3) Dear Giridhari holds Srimati Radharani's right hand, and together They gracefully stroll about. The gopis shower flowers before and behind Them, and one gopi fans them with a camara wisk.

s271.v:
(4)
parage dhusara sthala candra-kare su-sitala
manimaya bedira upare
rai kanu kara jodi' nrtya kare phiri' phiri'
parase pulake tanu bhare

s271.t: 4) That place is filled with the aromatic pollen of the lotus, and it is made pleasantly cool by the shining of the moon. On a raised platform there, Radha and Krsna dance, holding hands, the hairs of Their bodies standing up in ecstasy.

s272.v:
(1)
mrgamada-candana kare kari' sakhi-gana
barikhaye phula gandha-raje
srama-jala bindu bindu sobha kare mukha-indu
adhare murali kiba raje

s272.t: 1) The gopis decorate the Divine Couple with musk and sandalwood paste, and shower Them with aromatic flower. Drops of perspiration make Lord Krsna's moonlike face appear splendidly beautiful. The flute is gracefully placed agains Lord Krsna's lips.

s272.v:
(2)
hasa-bilasa-rasa sarala madhura bhasa
narottama-manoratha bharu
dunhuka bicitra besa kusuma racita kesa
locana-mohana lila karu

s272.t: 2) With the nectar of Their joking and laughter, and the sweetness of Their charming talks, the Divine Couple fulfills all the desires of Narottama dasa. Dressed in wonderful colorful garments, Their hair decorated with flowers, the Divine Couple performs pastimes, enchanting the eyes of everyone.

s273.v:
(1)
hari hari ki mora karama anurata
bisaye kutila-mati sat-sange na haila rati
kise ara taribara patha

s273.t: 1) My crooked mind delights in sense-gratification, but not in the association of the saintly devotees. Why do I follow this dangerous pathy? O Lord Hari, Lord Hari, how have I become so attached to materialism?

s273.v:
(2)
swarupa sanatana rupa raghunatha bhatta-juga
lokanatha siddhanta-sagara
sunitama se-saba katha ghucita manera byatha
tabe bhala haita antara

s273.t: 2) In the past I continually heard the philosophy of Krsna consciousness from Srila Svarupa Damodara Gosvami, Srila Sanatana Gosvami, Srila Rupa Gosvami; Srila Raghunatha dasa Gosvami, Srila Raghunatha Bhatta Gosvami, Srila Gopala Bhatta Gosvami, and Srila Lokanatha Gosvami, who is like a great ocean of devotional truth. By hearing their words the pain within my mind subsided, and I attained an auspicious condition of life.

s273.v:
(3)
jakhana gaura-nityananda adwaitadi-bhakta-brnda
nadiya-nagare abatara
takhana na haila janma ebe dehe kiba karma
micha matra bahi phiri bhara

s273.t: 3) Lord Caitanya, Lord Nityananda, Lord Advaita, and the devotees who are Their personal associates have descended from the spiritual world to the town of Nadiya. They have not taken birth as ordinary mortals do. How wonderful are Their transcendental activities! I am not like Them. I simply trudge along carrying a great heap of illusory materialistic burdens.

s273.v:
(4)
haridasa adi bule mahotsabapadi kare
na herinu se sukha-bilasa
ki mora duhkhera katha janama gonanu brtha
dhik dhik narottama dasa

s273.t: 4) Haridasa Thakura and the other devotees travelled about absorbed in a sonstant festival of the glorification of Lord Krsna, but i myself was unable to see these blissful pastimes. How sad is my tale. I have wasted my life. Fie, fie on Narottama dasa.

s274.v:
(1)
radha-krsna-sebon muni jibane marane
tanra sthana tanra lila dekhon ratri dine

s274.t: 1) I shall serve Sri Sri Radha and Krsna in this life and also afer my death. Night aned day I shall see Their transcendental abode and pastimes.

s274.v:
(2)
je sthane lila kare jugala-kisora
sakhira sangini hana tanhe hana bhora

s274.t: 2) Wherever the youthful Divine Couple shall go to perform transcendental pastimes I shall follow as an associate of Their gopi-frineds, and I shall stay with Them until sunrise.

s274.v:
(3)
sri-rupa-manjari-pada sebon nirabadhi
tanra pada-padma mora mantra-mahausadhi

s274.t: 3) I shall continually serve the lotus feet of Sri Rupa-manjari. Her lotus feet are my purifying mantra and my medicinal herb.

s274.v:
(4)
sri-rati-manjari devi more kara daya
anuksana deha tuya pada-padma-chaya

s274.t: 4) O Sri Rati-manjari-devi, please be merciful to me. Please give me the continual shade of your lotus feet.

s274.v:
(5)
sri-rasa-manjari devi kara abadhana
anuksana deha tuya pada-padma-dhyana

s274.t: 5) O Sri Rasa-manjari-devi, please notice me. please allow me to constantly meditate on your lotus feet.

s274.v:
(6)
brndabane nitya nitya jugala-bilasa
prarthana karaye sada narottama dasa

s274.t: 6) Please allow me to join the eternal pastimes of the Divine Couple in Vrndavana. Narottama dasa constantly prays in this way.

s275.v:
(1)
praneswari ei bara karuna kara more
dasanete trna dhari' anjali mastake kari'
ei-jana nibedana kare

s275.t: 1) This person places a straw between his teeth and his folded hands over his head. This person appeals to you. O queen of my life, please be merciful to me.

s275.v:
(2)
priya-sahacari-sange sebana kariba range
ange besa karibeka sadhe
rakha ei seba-kaje nija pada-pankaje
priya-sahacari-gana--majhe

s275.t: 2) Please engage me in the service of Your lotus feet. Please place me among Your gopi--associates. In their company I shall serve You with great happiness. I shall dress You in nice garments, and serve You in various ways.

s275.v:
(3)
sugandhi candana manimaya abharana
kausika basana nana range
ei saba seba janra dasi jena hana tanra
anhuksana thaki tanra sange

s275.t: 3) I shall anoint You with aromatic sandalwood paste. I shall happily decorate You with various silken garments and jewelled ornaments. I shall always stay near You as Your maidservant.

s275.v:
(4)
jala subasita kari' ratana bhrngare bhari'
karpura-basita guya pana
e-saba sajaiya dala labanga malati-mala
bhaksya-dravya nana anupama

s275.t: 4) I shall bring You fragrant water in a jewelled pitcher, and betel-nuts mixed with camphor. I shall bring You a clove-twig, a garland of jasmine flowers, and various imcomparably palatable foods.

s275.v:
(5)
sakhira ingita habe e-saba aniya kabe
jogaiba lalitara kache
narottama dasa kaya ei jena mora haya
dandaiya bahu sakhira pache

s275.t: 5) When shall I carry out every order hinted or gestured by the gopis? When shall I attain the association of Lalita--devi? Narottama dasa says: I hope that by praying in this way I shall some day become eligible to follow behind the gopi-frineds of the Divine Couple.

s276.v:
(1)
aruna-kamala-dale sesa bichaiba
basaiba kisora-kisori
alaka-abrta-mukha- pankaja manohyara
marakata-syam hema-gauri

s276.t: 1) When will I scatter red lotus petals before the charming youthful Divine Couple, whose lotus faces are nicely decorated with curling locks of hair, and who appear like a dark emerald accompanied by glittering gold?

s276.v:
(2)
praneswari kabe more habe krpa dithi
ajnaya aniya kabe bibidha phula-bara
sunaba racana dunhu mithi

s276.t: 2) O queen of my life, when will you place Your merciful glance upon me? When, directly hearing the orders of the Divine Couple, will I bring them various flowers and sweet candies?

s276.v:
(3)
mrgamada tilaka sa-sindura banayaba
lepaba candana-gandhe
ganthi malati-phula hara pahiraoba
dhaoyaba madhukara-brnde

s276.t: 3) When will I anoint the Divine Couple with tilaka markings made of musk and red sindura? When will I anoint Their bodies with sandalwood paste? When will I string a garland of jasmine flowers for Them, and then have to flee from the swarm of bumble-bees eager to claim the honey of those flowers?

s276.v:
(4)
lalita kabe more bijana deoyaba
bijana maruta mande
srama-jala sakala mitaba dunhu-kalebara
heraba parama anande

s276.t: 4) When, on Lalita's order, will I gently fan the Divine Couple, banishing the perspiration from Their transcendental bodies? When, will I see the Divine Couple, my heart filling with spiritual bliss?

s276.v:
(5)
narottama dasa asa pada-pankaja
sebana madhuri-pane
ho-oyaba hena dina na dekhiye kona cihna
dunhu-jana heraba nayane

s276.t: 5) Narottama dasa hopes that some day he will be able to drink the sweet honey of the service of the lotus feet of the Divine Couple. Will that day ever be? I do not see any indication that I will become able to directly see the Divine Couple with my own eyes.

s277.v:
(1)
prabhu he ei-bara karaha karuna
jugala-carana dekhi saphala kariba ankhi
ei mora manera kamana

s277.t: 1) The sight of the lotus feet of the Divine Couple will be the crowning success of my eyes. My heart and mind yearn to attain this sight. O Lord, please be merciful and grant this sight to me.

s277.v:
(2)
nija-pada-seba diba nahi more upekhiba
dunju pahu karuna-sagara
dunhu binu nahi janon ei bada bhagya manon
mui bada patita pamara

s277.t: 2) Please grant me the service of Your lotus feet. Do not neglect me, for You, my two Lords, are like two oceans filled with compassion. I know that You are full of all transcendental glory and opulence, and I do not know anyone except You. I am very fallen and sinful. Please be merciful to me.

s277.v:
(3)
lalita adesa pana carana sebiba yana
priya-sakhi sange haya mane
dunhu data-siromani ati dina more jani'
nikate carana dibe dane

s277.t: 3) By Your mercy I will attain the association of the gopis. By Your mercy I will become Lalita's maidservant, to be ordered about by her. By Your mercy I will attain the service of Your lotus feet. I know that You are both the two crest-jewels among all wealthy philanthropists, and You know that I am the poorest of the poor. Please, therefore, give me the charity of Your lotus feet.

s277.v:
(4)
paba radha-krsna-pa ghucibe manera gha
dure jabe e--saba biphala
narottama dase kaya ei bancha siddhi haya
deha prana sakala saphala

s277.t: 4) By Your mercy I will attain Your lotus feet. By Your mercy all the painful wounds in my mind will heal. By Your mercy my lack of success will go far away. Narottama dasa says: by Your mercy all my desires will be fulfilled, and this body and life will at last become fruitful.

s278.v:
(1)
aji rase badara nisi
preme bhasala saba brndabana-basi

s278.t: 1) Soon all the residents of Vrndavana will float in the nectar of pure love fror Radha and Krsna.

s278.v:
(2)
syama-ghana barikhaye prema-sudha-dhara
kore rangini radha bijuri-sancara

s278.t: 2) Sri Krsna is like a dark cloud which showers the nectar of pure love, and Srimati Radharani is like a movinglightning bolt sittting in the lap of that cloud.

s278.v:
(3)
preme pichala patha gamana bhela banka
mrgamada-candana-kunkume bhela panka

s278.t: 3) The path of love for Krsna is winding and crooked. It is slippery, and filled with mud mixed with kunkuma, sandalwood paste, and musk.

s278.v:
(4)
dig bidig nahi premera pathara
dubila narottama na jane santara

s278.t: 4) The great ocean of love of Krsna stretches without limit in all directions. Although Narottama dasa does not know how to swim across that ocean, he plunges headfirst into it.
